skill.name: ecommerce-livestream-overlay-generator
skill.description: Generates e-commerce livestream overlay assets from brand, product, promotion, and optional product photos. Includes prompt templates, compositing guidance, green screen removal, and packaging instructions.
skill.summary: Create livestream overlay packages with prompts, image processing steps, composite previews, and delivery guidance.
skill.author: gaoyuji12138

security_audit.summary: Most external-command findings are false positives from Markdown fences, prompt templates, or local Python snippets. Real risks remain around dependency installation, a curl request to a third-party image API, path traversal in zip output, OS open commands, and audit-evasion wording. No prompt injection aimed at the auditor was found.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions to avoid audit-triggering words. Replace them with guidance to make truthful, reviewable advertising claims.
Write archives inside a controlled output directory and sanitize brand names before using them in filenames.

remediation.issue: External API and command execution examples
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before pip, curl, zip, or open commands. Document what data is sent to third parties.
Tell users to store credentials in a secret manager or environment variable and never paste real keys into prompts.

content.value_statement: Livestream teams need fast, consistent visual packages for campaigns. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through prompts, compositing, and delivery assets for branded product overlays.
actual_capabilities: Collects brand, product, promotion, and optional style inputs before generation.
Defines prompts for background, title banner, host persona, price card, product shelf, and benefits bar.
Specifies Doubao image API request parameters and model choices for each component.
Provides Python snippets for green screen removal, product background cleanup, and compositing.
Describes fixed deliverables and packaging steps for seven overlay files.
limitations: Requires a Volcano Engine Doubao API key and compatible image generation access.
Uses example commands and snippets; users must verify dependencies and paths before execution.
Does not validate advertising claims, product rights, or brand authorization.
Generated host persona prompts may need review for platform and brand guidelines.

use_cases.title: Launch a Livestream Campaign
use_cases.description: Create a coordinated overlay set for a new product promotion with title, price, product, benefits, and preview assets.

use_cases.title: Convert Product Photos Into Assets
use_cases.description: Use a product image as the center item, remove simple backgrounds, and composite it into the livestream layout.

use_cases.title: Standardize Creative Production
use_cases.description: Give designers repeatable prompts, dimensions, layer order, and packaging rules for campaign overlay production.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Overlay Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with required campaign details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a livestream overlay set for Brand: [brand]. Product: [product]. Promotion: [promotion]. Use a polished e-commerce style.

prompt_templates.title: Use My Product Photo
prompt_templates.scenario: Campaign includes a user-provided product image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the overlay set using my product photo as the featured item. Keep the center shelf area clear and composite the product there.

prompt_templates.title: Match a Brand Style
prompt_templates.prompt: Create overlays for [brand] and [product] with [color palette], [mood], and [audience]. Include promotion copy and benefits text.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Delivery Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for final production output.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate all component prompts, describe processing steps, build the composite preview, and list the seven final files for delivery.

output_examples.input: A hair care brand needs a promotion overlay for a livestream sale.
output_examples.output: A campaign plan with title banner copy, host persona direction, pricing card text, product shelf direction, benefits copy, and preview composition notes.

output_examples.input: A seller provides a product photo with a light background.
output_examples.output: Background cleanup guidance, product placement instructions, adjusted product shelf prompt, and final overlay packaging steps.

output_examples.input: A creative team wants consistent files for each campaign.
output_examples.output: A fixed seven-file delivery checklist with dimensions, formats, transparency notes, and preview order.

best_practices: Confirm brand, product, promotion, and style before generating assets.
Review external API use, dependencies, and paths before running examples.
Check advertising claims and platform rules before publishing final overlays.
anti_patterns: Running commands with unsanitized brand names or file paths.
Sending product photos or campaign prompts to external APIs without permission.
Using audit-evasion wording or unverified guarantee claims in copy.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates guidance for livestream overlay assets, including prompts, processing steps, composite preview rules, and delivery files.

faq.question: Does it generate images by itself?
faq.answer: It describes image generation requests for Doubao models. Actual generation needs API access and user approval.

faq.question: Can I use my own product photo?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes simple background removal guidance and product compositing instructions for supplied photos.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I review before use?
faq.answer: Review external API calls, dependency installation, output paths, and advertising claims before executing any steps.

faq.question: Is it safe to publish without changes?
faq.answer: No. The audit identifies path handling, external API, command execution, and audit-evasion concerns that need fixes.
